Karnataka CM Announces Milk Price Hike Amid Drought Concerns

Karnataka Chief Minister Shivakumar has stated that a milk price hike is inevitable to protect farmers, citing drought conditions. This announcement comes as the state faces a broader cost-of-living increase, with milk and bus fares contributing to household expenses.
